description.zh: 你的代码会审专家——用 Google/Meta/Google-style review standards 审 Python/Go/TS/Rust 代码，从安全、性能、可维护性和测试覆盖四个维度给出分级（P0-P3）评审意见，并附修复方案与学习引导。
description.en: Your code review expert — reviews Python/Go/TS/Rust code against Google/Meta-style standards, delivering graded (P0-P3) feedback across security, performance, maintainability, and test coverage, with fix suggestions and learning guidance.

welcome_message.zh: 把你的代码或 diff 贴过来，我会逐文件、逐风险等级给出评审意见
welcome_message.en: Paste your code or diff and I'll review it file by file, risk level by risk level

description.zh: 检查注入、认证绕过、密钥泄露等 OWASP Top 10 安全风险
description.en: Scan for injection, auth bypass, credential leakage and other OWASP Top 10 risks

prompt.zh:
请对以下代码进行安全审查，重点关注 OWASP Top 10 漏洞（注入、认证、密钥泄露、XSS 等），给出 P0-P3 分级问题列表和修复建议：

```
[粘贴你的代码]
```
prompt.en:
Please review the following code for security issues, focusing on OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities (injection, auth, credential leakage, XSS, etc.), and provide a P0-P3 graded issue list with fix suggestions:

```
[paste your code]
```

description.zh: 分析 N+1 查询、内存泄漏、时间复杂度、并发瓶颈等性能热点
description.en: Analyze N+1 queries, memory leaks, time complexity, concurrency bottlenecks and other hotspots

prompt.zh:
请对以下代码进行性能扫描，找出 N+1 查询、内存泄漏、不合理的时间复杂度、并发瓶颈等问题，按 P0-P3 分级并给出优化方案：

```
[粘贴你的代码]
```
prompt.en:
Please scan the following code for performance issues — N+1 queries, memory leaks, suboptimal time complexity, concurrency bottlenecks — grade them P0-P3 and suggest optimizations:

```
[paste your code]
```

description.zh: 评审命名、结构、注释、耦合度、API 设计等可维护性维度
description.en: Review naming, structure, comments, coupling, API design and other maintainability dimensions

prompt.zh:
请从可维护性角度评审以下代码：命名规范、函数结构、注释质量、模块耦合、API 设计、是否符合 SOLID 原则，给出改进建议：

```
[粘贴你的代码]
```
prompt.en:
Please review the following code for maintainability — naming conventions, function structure, comment quality, module coupling, API design, SOLID compliance — and suggest improvements:

```
[paste your code]
```

zh: 每天「10:00」扫描指定 git 仓库新 PR，自动输出评审报告
每周五「17:00」整理本周团队代码中的高频反模式并给出培训建议
每次 PR 提交前自动运行 AI 审查标记 P0/P1 问题
en: Every day at 10:00, scan new PRs in the target git repo and auto-generate a review report
Every Friday at 17:00, summarize recurring anti-patterns in the team's code this week and suggest training topics
Auto-run AI review before each PR submission and flag P0/P1 issues
